What we teach

Four pillars, one basic school.

From the first alphabet to the final Matric exam, every LOBS classroom is built around the same four commitments.

01

Oxford Based Studies

A structured, internationally benchmarked curriculum from Play Group onward.

02

Hifz-e-Quran

Dedicated memorization classes alongside the regular academic timetable.

03

Personality Grooming

Confidence, conduct and leadership habits, built in from the earliest years.

04

Modern Teaching

An electronic-first approach — LOBS was Multan's first electronic school.
